caveats: Actual native50Hz full-body poses and exact contact/landing events; no generated or interpolated motion.
All six comparison cases were registered before this new centered training. Not blind/random sampling.
New075 reward stage with only the source outer actor/normalizer copied; fresh critic/Adam/RNG/counters, one unchanged fixed old8 base.
Last valid50Hz sample is explicitly distinguished from exact terminal or landing substeps.
Fixed per-case orthographic cameras fit the actual recorded mesh bounds; exact contact has a separate fitted camera. This is a visual replay update, not a new experiment.
View labels and time labels sit outside the420px image panes; viewport coverage does not assert that every mesh surface is unoccluded.
